title: Epiphone Masterbilt Excellente, Antique Natural Aged

long_description.title: Rare Vintage Classic! Now Available for the First Time Since 1970
long_description.body:
Perhaps the rarest Epiphone model ever made, only 139 Excellente acoustic guitars were produced between 1963-70. The beautifully ornate, top-of-the-line Excellente was made famous by country music legend Loretta Lynn, and now it returns as part of the new Masterbilt™ Collection. Featuring a solid Sitka spruce top, solid ovangkol back and sides, an ebony fingerboard with historic pearl cloud inlays, bone nut and saddle, and gold vintage-style Waffleback tuners. Powered by the Fishman® Presys VT™ onboard preamp system, it's ready for the studio or stage. Featuring Gibson™ strings. Epiphone stands behind every guitar they make with a Limited Lifetime Warranty and Gibson Brands™ Customer Service.

A battery is not included. To power your pickup, you will need a 9-volt battery.

Neck Specs.Neck Material: Maple with 5 piece Walnut and Maple center stripe

Electronics Specs.Controls: Fishman® Presys VT™ soundhole mounted Volume and Tone

Hardware Specs.Bridge: Ebony; Excellente shape with pearl dot inlays
Hardware Specs.Tuning Machines: Gold Vintage Waffleback tuners with metal buttons

Misc Specs.Case: Optional Acoustic AJ/Dreadnought Hard Case 940-EDREAD; Dread/AJ Acoustic EpiLite™ Case 940-EDREADHG
Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Large mother of pearl Excellente block with Cloud extensions
Misc Specs.Strings Gauge: Gibson™ Phosphor Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings .012, .016, .024w, .032 .042, .053
